The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a crafting station introduced with the Stranger Sins DLC, that may be built in the [[cellar]] after the [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Zombie-winery]] technology has been unlocked. Here, a [[zombie]] can work towards producing [[red wine]] from [[grapes]]. This workstation has a pre-designated location in the top-left corner of the cellar, with the [[Zombie-brewery]] in the opposite corner.

'''Note:''' The player can't work at this station on their own, the products must be queued and the zombie then prepares them. It's possible to order several products at once in a task queue.
